name: Superincreasing Recurrence Obfuscation
description: Replaced the obvious base-2 capacity recurrence (which models pattern-match to Exact Cover) with a k-dependent linear recurrence C_i = (k+1)C_{i-1} + 1. This preserves the unique multiset sum property required for 3-Dimensional Matching, but breaks surface-level heuristic triggers. Models must now genuinely analyze the recurrence to prove it forces an exact cover, otherwise they will fall back to naive subset-sum approaches that TLE or overflow.
